rules: Every article must cite one of the verified experience areas. An article that could be written without the author's own work is a tutorial, and offers no advantage.
Malaysia (MYS) articles link outward to their global counterpart and never restate it.
No article claims RPOMS modules beyond the Daily Report are writing in production.
No article claims ResearchForge performs retrieval or is a RAG system.
Figma-based design and prototyping on ERTH is supported evidence (the ERTH V2.3 prototype). Sole design authorship is not.
Location is used only where the search intent or local context genuinely differs. No city-swap variants.
